messages:
Maya: Heads-up — reading the region availability doc and noticed we don't link to the data residency footnote for regulated customers. We should add an explicit footnote and a link to the residency matrix.
Sam: totally. which file did you look at? region-availability.md?
Maya: Yes, docs/platform/region-availability.md. The 'Supported regions' table lists EU & APAC but no residency guarantees. Customers are asking.
Julian: We intentionally kept the guarantees out of the main page and put details on /compliance/data-residency but ok to add a footnote + link. Suggest text: "Data residency options vary by deployment — see /compliance/data-residency for details." Thoughts?
Maya: That wording works. Also add a small footnote marker on the table header for "Regions".
Kevin: can we be explicit about which regions support customer-managed keys (KMS)? Folks asked about HSM too.
Anita: I can draft the PR. Will include a tiny migration note for Dedicated customers who might need to reconfigure KMS when switching regions.
Sam: include an SDK snippet for showing `client.set_region('eu-west-1')` and mention that residency is orthogonal to model selection.
Maya: add a one-line note about latency tradeoffs when routing to a different region.
DocsBot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 by @anita. CI: docs build succeeded :white_check_mark:
Anita: pinging @kevin @julian for copy review, left TODOs in the PR for KMS table and the APAC entry.
Kevin: looked — suggested tweak on the KMS column header to "Encryption key (KMS/HSM)" and small rephrase.
Julian: approved the technical bits, left one nit about wording "residency guarantees" -> "data residency controls".
Maya: thanks all — once merged can we backport to the v1 docs branch? some customers still use it.
Anita: will open backport PR after merge.
Sam: should we add an automated link checker for external compliance links? saw a broken external last week.
Maya: yeah adding that is another follow-up item. For now merging this is higher priority.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Maya: merging in a bit if no objections. Thanks!
